name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Names an icon-only control and its key: a graphite pill chip in the label role, SELECT · V with the key dimmed, 10 from the trigger after 120 ms, grouped so the next trigger shows at once; flips near the edge; fades on settle. Built on Base UI Tooltip.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/tooltip.md. SwiftUI: View.metalTooltip(_:shortcut:edge:) in the MetalUI Swift package.
